pull_request.title: Day 3 Review Copilot 실습
pull_request.body:
## Goal

Review Copilot 검토 결과와 회귀 테스트 증거를 Draft PR로 전달합니다.

## Scope

- Changed files: labs/day3/review_copilot/fixtures/repository/meeting_export.py
- Intentionally unchanged: 자동 게시, 자동 comment, 자동 merge, 실제 고객 데이터

## Safety and data

- [x] No secret, token, real customer data, or private meeting data is included.
- [x] File, tool, and external-write boundaries remain explicit.
- [x] Human approval is preserved for consequential actions.

## Test evidence

~~~text
python -m pytest -q tests/test_day3_review_copilot.py
~~~
- Result: PASSED · exit_code=0
- Added/updated normal test: golden safe-negative와 허용 workflow
- Added/updated failure or boundary test: path escape와 Human Review 차단

## Review request

- Risk to inspect: 입력 문자열의 코드 실행
- Expected behavior: P0 labs/day3/review_copilot/fixtures/repository/meeting_export.py:7 입력 문자열의 코드 실행; P1 labs/day3/review_copilot/fixtures/repository/meeting_export.py:9 사람 승인 없는 외부 서비스 호출; P2 labs/day3/review_copilot/fixtures/repository/meeting_export.py:10 실패 원인을 지우는 예외 처리
- Human review: APPROVED · 수강생 · 근거 라인과 최소 교정을 확인했습니다.
- Known limitation: AI review는 merge 승인이 아니며 실제 대상은 사람이 재확인

## Human merge checklist

- [ ] Diff matches the stated goal.
- [ ] CI is green.
- [ ] Review findings were fixed or answered with a reason.
- [ ] AI review output was treated as advice, not approval.
- [ ] A human checked the final diff and merge target.

github_dry_run.next_step: 사람이 diff·test·target을 다시 확인한 뒤 명령을 한 줄씩 실행
